paragraphs: Enhanced Voting sells an electronic ballot delivery solution for states and localities. Alongside it the company offers a public reporting product that displays election results in visual and interactive formats. A third product lets staff remake unreadable ballots with less effort and fewer mistakes. The company also supports Ballot Scout, described as vote-by-mail tracking for voters and election administrators built on USPS IMB scans.

With Enhanced Ballot, voters can access their precinct-specific ballot to mark and download it. The platform is presented as fully accessible to voters using assistive technologies like screen readers, screen magnifiers, and speech input software. The company describes it as a way for military and overseas voters to securely download their specific ballots. It states that the platform conforms to federal ADA standards. The remake product ships as a cart holding a touchscreen interface, a dual camera system, label printer, barcode scanner, and a ballot printer. Enhanced Results aggregates and validates data and displays it through maps, interactive graphs, and customizable public websites.

The company says its technology is developed, maintained, and audited by election security experts. Officials quoted on the site include a former deputy elections director from the Oregon Secretary of State office. An election services director at the Virginia Department of Elections also appears among the testimonials.

quote.text: Developed, maintained, and audited by election security experts.
